services.name: Disc Golf
services.desc: Disc rentals for the Shaunavon disc golf course will be available to sign out at the Town Office for a deposit of $40 per set, which will be returned once all discs are returned in good-condition. Discs are available for rent over 3 days. If discs are not returned within three days, the deposit will not be refunded.

services.name: Heritage Walking Tour
services.desc: Shaunavon’s Heritage Walking Tour was made possible through the hard work and dedication of the volunteers and staff of the Grand Coteau Heritage & Cultural Centre. Many thanks to the Town of Shaunavon and the Saskatchewan Heritage Foundation for their funding support, to The Shaunavon Standard newspaper for assisting with research, and to our visitors for your interest in the heritage of our community. The information you will learn on this tour is only a small part of the history of our community.
